news.title: World Cup winner Gavi surprises Barcelona fans with bold new look ahead of new season
news.lede: FC Barcelona fans were already eager to see Gavi back on the training ground after his World Cup triumph with Spain national football team, but the young midfielder gave supporters another reason to talk this week by unveiling a striking new look as preparations for the season intensify. Barcelona held another training session Friday at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper, the club’s final workout before traveling to Udine for Saturday’s triangular tournament. While much of the attention was on tactics and squad readiness, Gavi’s refreshed appearance quickly became a major talking point among fans and Spanish media. The 22-year-old recently returned from vacation following Spain’s World Cup victory and only resumed training this week.

news.title: Messi targeted in bomb threats during World Cup – Report
news.lede: Argentina's forward #10 Lionel Messi has tears in his eyes as celebrates winning the 2026 World Cup round of 16 football match between Argentina and Egypt at Atlanta Stadium in Atlanta on July 7, 2026. (Photo by Odd ANDERSEN / AFP). A police report has uncovered a plot to assassinate Argentine football icon, Lionel Messi, during the 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada, according to Spanish newspaper MARCA. According to the report, several suspects allegedly threatened to detonate explosives and storm stadiums where Messi was playing.

news.title: Pitso Mosimane Returns for Bafana Bafana Head Coach Role After Historic World Cup Campaign
news.lede: Rabat - The South African Football Association (SAFA) National Executive Committee has approved the appointment of Pitso Mosimane as the new Bafana Bafana head coach, paving the way for his return to the national team more than a decade after his first spell in charge. SAFA confirmed the decision following an extraordinary NEC meeting held at SAFA House on Saturday, August 8, 2026. Danny Jordaan, the president of the South African Football Association (SAFA), said the NEC had backed Mosimane, although some administrative details still need to be completed before the appointment is formally announced. “The NEC has approved the appointment of coach Pitso to Bafana Bafana, but we still need to tie up some loose ends,” Jordaan said.

news.title: Rare FIFA World Cup Records: Nations Winning Consecutively
news.lede: Winning back-to-back FIFA World Cup titles is an exceedingly rare achievement, one that only two nations have managed to accomplish. However, three countries have succeeded in clinching the title twice within three tournaments. Brazil first achieved this with victories in 1962 and 1970, despite not winning in 1966. Argentina followed with wins in 1978 and 1986.

news.title: Manuel Neuer: Redefining Goalkeeping & World Cup Heroics
news.lede: Manuel Neuer is renowned as a groundbreaking goalkeeper, known for his aggressive and unique playing style. While some may view his approach as risky, it has undoubtedly led to significant accolades, including being a pivotal figure in Germany's World Cup victory in 2014. Neuer did not invent the role of the sweeper keeper, but he elevated it with his quick reflexes and daring plays, challenging opposition strikers by converting defensive plays into offensive launches. Neuer's goalkeeping prowess became integral to his teams' successes, from his two-decade tenure at Schalke, where he started at age five, to his transformative years with Bayern Munich.

news.title: Lionel Messi subjected to World Cup murder threat, US authorities reveal
news.lede: Spanish newspaper Marca has disclosed details from a chilling American police report, which lists all the security threats faced by the FBI and the International Police Cooperation Center (IPCC) this summer. According to the news outlet, Argentina superstar Messi received more threats than any other player throughout the tournament. The risk extended to his national teammates, with the report revealing one plot during their final group game against Jordan. One man is said to have rung up Dallas Airport and warned that he and two others would storm the stadium with "homemade bombs and an AR-15 [rifle]."

news.title: Is football AI-proof? Why tech investors wanted a slice of the World Cup
news.lede: Fifa has been forced to U-turn on plans to sell off a slice of the World Cup after fierce opposition, with threats of future boycotts and calls for the governing body's president, Gianni Infantino, to quit. But why were a group of tech investors interested in the World Cup in the first place, and are similar proposals in the future inevitable? In a world in which AI could upend human recreation and pastimes, executives at Thrive Eternal, a spin-off of venture capital firm Thrive Capital, saw an opportunity to lead a group of investors to place cash in the biggest sporting competition on the planet. The football World Cup was seen as the latest in a new strategy from the firm, which believes that sport will not only survive the AI revolution, but grow in value.

news.title: Argentine football prez: Lionel Messi alone will decide when to retire
news.lede: Especially after witnessing what Lionel Messi was still capable of at this summer's World Cup, the president of the Argentina Football Association is not rushing the all-time great out the door. Claudio "Chiqui" ​Tapia said in an interview on Argentine TV that Messi is the only person ‌making the decision when to hang up his boots. "It's a decision that is purely and personally his," Tapia said, according to a translation. "You have to let him relax.
